note: Static project edges that break the package map in docs/PACKAGES.md, carried until each is worked off. Read by check-lib-boundaries.mjs (which is red for an edge missing here AND for a row the graph no longer has) and by eslint.config.mjs (which turns each row into an `allow` override scoped to the source project). This list may shrink and must never grow: a new cross-package edge is refused, not recorded. The fix for each edge is in docs/PACKAGES.md under 'Violations', where every plugin-to-plugin row has its own numbered remedy naming the core seam that retires it; a `why` here says what the edge was for, and the doc's row says what crosses today, which for four rows is no longer the same thing.
